topics.titleTr: Qwik ve Resumability: Sıfır Hidrasyon Değer mi?

topics.brief: Sections: hydration's cost and how resumability skips it by serializing state into HTML; how Qwik lazy-loads handlers on interaction; real wins (instant TTI on large pages) vs costs (ecosystem, mental model, serialization gotchas); where RSC/islands already close the gap; who should actually pick it. Verify: Qwik resumability model in 2026; benchmarks vs hydrated frameworks; ecosystem maturity. Sources: Qwik docs; framework-performance writeups. Contrarian: for most sites, islands/RSC beat switching frameworks. Distinct from Astro/Next and signals posts.
